MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Amazing Grace feels like a natural choice because a familiar hymn fits the warm, traditional vocal mood I associate with my recent Christmas listening.",
    "Joey+Rory Inspired also sounds appealing because its inspirational direction connects with that mood, although I would only choose Amazing Grace this time."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Country hits and romance albums do not give me the same connection to familiar, comforting songs; a traditional sound alone is not enough to make me choose them.",
    "A relaxing classical collection misses my wish to hear songs and voices, while WOW Hits 2016 feels too broad and contemporary for the familiar traditional music I want.",
    "I cannot connect Visions / Expressions / Portrait to my recent listening, so I have little reason to try it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The choices seem to treat country music and older hits as broadly interchangeable with the warm vocal music I have been enjoying.",
    "An inspirational or Christian connection seems to count too much on its own; familiar hymns appeal to me more right now than a broad contemporary compilation."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated Christmas album listening suggests that familiar songs and a seasonal mood mattered, rather than just a general interest in traditional music.",
    "My latest interaction with The New Old Fashioned deserves attention alongside the earlier holiday listening, rather than assuming I still want only Christmas music.",
    "I rarely try something without a clear connection to my interests, so a loosely related album is unlikely to draw me in."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in comforting, inspirational songs but stretched that interest too far into general country hits and loosely related collections."
}
